title: release-provenance prints the acknowledge_dangling_provenance input raw inside a workflow-command line
description: LCLI-630 reviewer, info-level (2026-09-28): scripts/release-provenance.mjs:909 (also 942) prints the ACKNOWLEDGE dispatch input inside ::warning::, trimming only its ends. An API dispatch with an interior newline could print forged workflow commands in provenance-pre, a contents: read job. This gains no privilege, since anyone with dispatch rights can already run a modified workflow from a branch, but a log and annotation forgery is a defect.

acceptanceCriteria.text: release-provenance.mjs prints the acknowledge_dangling_provenance input in ::warning:: / ::notice:: lines only after escaping CR, LF and % (or refuses an input containing them), so an API dispatch cannot forge workflow commands; a test covers CR, LF and %0A
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; reviewer pass
